title: AgentRunResult.v1
description: The outcome of one AgentRunRequest. PROPOSAL only: serves_truth is always false — an agent run produces a CANDIDATE output that returns to Baltor's governance rail (store/verify/reconcile), never served or promotable truth. status is one of succeeded|failed|unavailable (unavailable = the harness could not run, e.g. a candidate runtime like OpenClaw/Hermes is not imported/executed in this repo). tool_calls/skills_loaded/sandbox_events/policy_violations record WHAT THE AGENT DID for audit; output_contract_valid reports whether the proposed output matched its declared output contract (still a candidate even when valid). The output is the thing being PROPOSED, not a fact the spine vouches for.

status.description: succeeded = harness ran to a result; failed = ran but errored; unavailable = could not run (candidate runtime not imported/executed; missing local capability)

output.description: inline agent output when small + non-sensitive; the PROPOSED candidate artifact, never auto-served

output_ref.description: ResourceRef-style handle to the agent output when large or sensitive

output_contract_valid.description: true if the proposed output validated against its declared output contract; a valid output is still a candidate, never truth

tool_calls.description: ordered record of tool invocations the agent made (for audit; each constrained to the request allowlist)

skills_loaded.description: ids of skills loaded during the run (progressive disclosure; agent-created skills remain candidate)

sandbox_events.description: sandbox lifecycle/violation events (e.g. network_blocked, host_exec_blocked) recorded during the run

policy_violations.description: any policy violations detected (denied tool attempted, secret-value attempted, cross-tenant memory attempted); a non-empty list blocks promotion

receipt_id.description: id of the AgentRunReceipt emitted for this run; null when status=unavailable and no receipt was produced

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — an agent run is a proposal/candidate, never served or promotable truth
